content: Paul Sails for Rome
Noqw itam pāvaqe Italyt aqwyaniqat pan yukiltiqw, puma hakiy Julius yan mātsiwhqat aw Paul pētuy sivilalwaqamuy enaṅ noaya; pam hak Augustus solāwamuyatuy amuṅaqw tsivót‐sikip sunat amumi moṅwi.
Noqw itam pākihut Adramyttium aṅqwnihqat aqw yuṅqe, Asiat qaqlavaqe hinwisniqey tunatyawk̇ahk̇aṅw, pāvaqe hoyoyoykuya; noqw hak Aristarchus, Macedoniat ep Thessalonicat aṅqw sino, itamuma.
Qavoṅvaqw itam Sidon ep öki. Noqw Julius Paul aw su’panihqe, pay kwatsmuy amuminen, suyan unaṅwtiniqat put nakwhana.
Noqw itam paṅqw ahpiyyaqe Cyprus ehpeq hoyoyotota, Cyprus itamuhsa’ hukw’uhtsiwtaq’ö.
Noqw itam Ciliciat‐nik̇aṅw Pamphyliat pumuy qalavaqe pātuwaqatsit aṅqe’ hoyóyototak̇aṅw, Lyciat ep wuhkokitsokit Myra yan mātsiwhqat aw öki.
Noqw pep Alexandriat aṅqw pākihu Italyt aqwniqat solāwamoṅwi túwahqe, itamuy paṅsoq taṅata.
Noqw itam wūhakis tālat aṅ pāvaqe híhin hoyóyototaqe, k̇ānanaptat, Cnidus aqlavo öki; noqw hūk̇aṅw itamuy qa nakwhanaqw, ōviy itam Crete yoñiyat aṅhqe Salmonat ehpeqya.
Nihqe itam híhinhaqam put ruhpakyaqe haqam Lomayoñipsö yan mātsiwhqat aw öki; put aqlap kitsóki Lasea yan mātsiwa.
Noqw wūyavotiqw, pay napwaltalöṅnit aṅ ayo ruhpakq, ōviy pāvaqe nuhtsel’ewayhinhtiqw, pahsat pu Paul hintaniqat pumuy āawnaqe,
Amumi paṅqawu: Tōtimu, sumataq itam yaṅhqe haqamiyak̇aṅw, a’nö hinhtotini; pas himu a’nö súlawhtini, qa umuhhoi‐saa, pu qa pākihu‐saa, pas itahqatsi pīwu.
Noqw pay solāwamoṅwi pākihut wárikni’maqat aw‐nik̇aṅw pu put himuy’taqat púmuy‐sa amumi tuqayvasta, qa Paul lavayiyat aw’i.

Noqw pep pösö qalomáhintaqw, kurs hin hak pep kwaṅwátömölaniqw, pay ōviy suswuhaqnihqam paṅqw ahpiyyaniqey nānawakna, pay sen as puma Phenicet aw ök̇e’, pep tömölayaniqey ōviy’o; pam Crete ep hötsiwa, tātöq‐tēveṅe qātsi, pu kwiniwiq‐tēveṅee.
The Storm at Sea
Noqw tatk̇aqw sūmawvaqw, puma tunatyay aw yórikyaqey wūwayaqe, wiwamniy rupamnayaqe, pahpiy hoyóyoykuyaqe, Crete áhayhk̇e’ pāyawwisa.
Noqw pay nāt ahpiy qa wūyavotiqw, kwiniñaqw, pu hōpaqw amuhtsava wukohukva itamuhpewii.
Noqw pākihu sóonhtiqe, kurs hin hūk̇aṅwuy ehpewi yūmo hóyokniqw, itam náwustotaqw pam huhukhoya.
Noqw itam pāṅaqw tutskwat kuytaqat Clauda yan matsiwhqat yoñiyat aṅqe’ huhukhoyyaqe k̇ānanaptat, pākihut mask̇ay’wisqey áṅwutota.
Noqw puma put wupnayaqe, hihta mask̇ay pākihut kwewtoynaya; nāphisat k̇a sen puma tsivohk̇at aqw huhukhoyyaniqe, puma mötsápvuyalnit hawnayaqe pahpiy huhukhoyya.
Noqw pas itam hūk̇aṅwuy akw paysoq nāhoy tutuptiwyaqw, ōviy qavoṅvaqw puma pākihut aṅqw putuyat pētsaṅwaya.
Pu aṅk talöṅvaqat ep itam nāp itahmay akw pākihut hihta a’wiwayat maspaya.
Noqw wūhakis talöṅvaqat aṅ tāwa, pu sōtu pas qa mātsiltotiqw, pas itamumi qaan’ewakw hūhukq, pahsat pu itam pay hin ayo nö́ṅakniqey naṅ’eknaya.

Noqw pas puma wūhakis qa nȫnösaqw, pahsat pu Paul pumuy amuhsonve wunuptuqe paṅqawu: Tōtimu, pas as uma inumi tuqayvastote’, Crete aṅqw qa ahpiyyanik̇aṅwo, nen qa yanhaqam okiwhinhtotini, pu hihta kwayhyani.
Noqw pay nu umumi paṅqawni: Uma hahlayyani, pay qa haqawa umuṅaqw qatsiy kwayhni; pay pākihu‐sa súlawhtini.
Pi nu God sinoatnik̇aṅw put eṅem tumalay’ta. Noqw put hoṅviayaat pu’ it tōkilat ep inuhpeq wunuk̇aṅw,
Inumi paṅqawu: Pay um qa tsawiniwtani, Paul; pay um pas soon Caesar atpipo qa wīkiwni; noqw meh, God hapi utsviy sohsokmuy umum hoyóyototaqamuy ayo óyani.
Noqw ōviy’o, tōtimu, uma qa hin unaṅway’yuṅwni; pi nu God qapēvewnaqw, pas inumi hin lavayhtiqw, soon pam qa antani.
Nīk̇aṅw pay itam haqam pāṅaqw tutskwat kuytaqat soon aw qa hukhoyyani.
Noqw pakwt nālöq sihk̇ay’tasikis míhikqat ep itam Adriat aṅqe’ nāhoy huhukhoylalwaqw, tōkilnasaveqhaqam ima pākihut tumalay’yuṅqam yaw sumataq haqami tutskwat aw hayiṅwnayaqey wūwaya;
Nihqe pāmiq hötsítuwantotaqe, sunát‐sikip mamkit pan hötsit nanapta; nit pu ahpiy híhin yūmoyat piw tuwantotaqw, pahsat pay pakwt tsivot sihk̇ay’tasikip mamki.
Pahsat pu k̇a sen itam o’wat aqw óṅokyaniqw, puma pākihut ahkwayñavoqw nālöq putuhaynit pāmiq maspayat, tālawvaniqat maqaptsi’yuṅwa.
Noqw pākihut tumalay’yuṅqam watqaniqey tunatyawyuṅqe, pākihut moṅaqw putuhaynit maspayaniqey atsáy’k̇ahk̇aṅw, tsākw pākihut pāmiq hāhawnayaqw,
Paul solāwamoṅwi aw‐nik̇aṅw pu solāwamuy amumi paṅqawu: Pas ima pākihut ep qa huruhtotiqw, soon uma ayo nö́ṅakni.
Pahsat pu solāwam tsākw pākihut somiyat tutkitotaqw, pam pohsi.
Noqw tālawiwmaqw, puma sohsoyam nȫnösaniqat Paul amumi öqalti paṅqawk̇aṅwo: Pu’ hapi pakwt nālöq sihk̇ay’taqat tālat aṅ uma tusiiwyuṅqe, nātsöṅkwayni’yuṅwa, qa hihta nȫnösaqee.
Noqw ōviy nu umumi paṅqawni: Uma nȫnösani, nen öqawi’yuṅwni; pay soon umuy haqawat qötöyat aṅqw sūk̇a hȫmi súlawhtini.
Yan pam lavayhtit, pölavikit kwusuhqe, pumuy sohsokmuy amutpik put ep God aw hahlayhtit, yōhaqe tūmoyva.
Pahsat pu puma hahlayhtotiqe tuwat nōnova.
Noqw itam pākihut aṅqw sūmiyaqe (276) pakwt payhkomuy sihk̇ay’tasikip súnatnik̇aṅw aṅqw pakwt nāvay sihk̇ay’yuṅwa.
Noqw ōviy puma ȫöyaqe, pahsat pākihut putuyat pētsaṅwantotaqe, pāmiq söhövosit maspitota.
The Shipwreck
Noqw tālawvaqw, puma tutskwat qa māmatsya; noqw haqami pösöy’taqat aṅ tutskway’taqw, pay k̇a as hin pasiwtaniqw puma paṅsoq pākihut panayaniqey wūwaya.
Pu puma putuhaynit yayvanayaqe pāmiq nātatamhtotaqe, ponilanpiyat hihta akw sómiwtaqat ṅáṅahtotat, mohpeq mötsápvuyalnit hūk̇anwuy aqwwat pūyaknayat, pāhut qalavoq öqaltoti.
Nihqe puma haqam pāhu namiptsiwtaqat aw huhukwhoyyaqe pākihut tsivoktota; noqw móṅaqwnihqa hūrstiqe pas qa poninita; noqw yūmoqnihqa pāhut hoṅvantaqat a’nö öqalayat akw sakwíiwma.
Noqw solāwamuy wuwniamniqw as pay puma sivilalwaqamuy qöqyani, taq k̇a himuwa qalavo momorstime’ wāyaniqw ōviy’o.
Noqw solāwamoṅwi as Paul ayo táviniqey nāwaknaqe, pumuy tunatyayamuy aṅqw ahoy ṅuy’ta; nihqe momorstuwi’yuṅqam mohti pāmiq tsotsó’ye’ tutskwami nö́ṅakniqat paṅqawu,
Pu ahpiy haqawat wunavutsit pu pākihut sakwítiqat aṅqw hiṅsaq hihta hinyuṅqat aṅ tsokiwk̇ahk̇aṅwyaniqata. Noqw pan puma sohsoyam qa hinhtotit tutskwami nȫṅa.
